observations.posthog_connection: This parameter distinguishes warehouse pipeline v3, where the incremental cursor is staged and not promoted until completion, from v2, where it is durable. The helper now clears `rows_synced` on retry for v3, while preserving it for v2, preventing double-counting of rows in billing and usage reports.
